name: Utsukushihime ~Mahou Choukyou Monogatari~
original_name: うつくしひめ ～魔法調教物語～
source:
The evil "Madou Empire" has beaten the last remaining country, "Grandis Kanan." As Leno sits in the ruins of the palace savoring this great victory, he uncovers a plot to kill him. Princess Farina of the fallen kingdom is behind this scheme. The emperor of the Madou Empire is impressed with the resistant and hostile attitude of this princess and orders Leno to train her as a sex slave, worthy of the emperor. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020613201554/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/a/utsukushi/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
邪恶的「魔导帝国」击败了最后残存的国家「格兰迪斯·卡南」。雷诺坐在宫殿废墟中品味这场大胜时，发现了一项刺杀自己的阴谋。亡国的法丽娜公主正是幕后主使。魔导帝国的皇帝对这名公主不屈又敌对的态度印象深刻，下令雷诺将她调教成配得上皇帝的性奴。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020613201554/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/a/utsukushi/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
